observations: ME examples show an approach/chest-pointing hold; WE examples include lateral movement across the upper torso. These are visual observations, not certified semantic annotations.
In ME P30 and P36, sampled frames show a visible hand at the chest without a skeleton overlay. Presence flags therefore cannot be treated as accurate sign segmentation.
The WE P2 sheet covers a short tracked interval; the rest of its 117 decoded frames also need to be considered when interpreting its 14 detected-hand frames.
Hand points are compact/partly occluded near the chest in multiple clips; the front-view sheets do not establish true depth or anatomical accuracy.

limits: Two performances per label/condition, not a general accuracy estimate.
Unscorable captures are reported separately, not as predicted wrong signs.
Timed windows are proxies; fixed normalization uses retrospective full-capture context.
Aggregate presence/motion does not prove accurate joints. Conditions are distinct performances.

observed_image_notes: Four RAM boards were inspected. In first-capture samples the index joints are compressed in projection; one sample places tip 8 almost on top of MCP 5.
The user confirmed the first index was straight toward the camera. A front-facing still cannot establish true physical depth or exact joint error.
Second-capture samples show a visibly extended index with greater projected spread; YOU is still not the first guess.

The live thumb is laterally extended in these samples; the selected P12 reference has a more tucked thumb. Different views/shapes are observed, but no semantic gesture error or causal mechanism is established.
you_landmark_review.interpretation: View-dependent and compressed hand estimates are a supported concern. Compression alone cannot explain both errors; the second capture is also YES. No universal correction is established.
limits: Four selected stills from two confirmed captures, not a measured landmark error rate or general accuracy.
Public probes are middle tracked frames, which can include transitions/rest. No fitted threshold or classifier.
Estimated local z is not measured physical hand depth. Softmax scores are not calibrated correctness probabilities.
Five- and fifteen-label tasks have different chance levels and samples; rank within vocabulary.
Five-class top-five is automatically 100%, not discriminative.
All saved epochs are retrospective test comparisons; existing validation selections stay unchanged.
Historical full-vocabulary experiments already used these official test signers/videos; no claim of a newly sealed holdout.
Dataset test scores do not establish webcam accuracy.
small_vocab_test_benchmark.best_artifact_scope_note: The best.pt name identifies a pre-existing per-run artifact; readout C-grid entries include candidates that were not selected as the final model.

5.interpretation: Output logits restricted and renormalized to the same pilot labels; original 2731-output weights/head unchanged, no training.

15.interpretation: Output logits restricted and renormalized to the same pilot labels; original 2731-output weights/head unchanged, no training.

limits: Restricted scores renormalize the released 2731 outputs; no weights or head were retrained.
Released I3D trained on the full vocabulary; small project models trained on selected-class subsets. This is not an architecture-only ablation.
182 chosen official test videos are not the entire 32941-video official test set; no published-score reproduction claim.
The epoch-5 GRU was identified retrospectively by its test score.
Order-dependent upstream endpoint padding is seeded/disclosed. A separate confirmed four-trial webcam check is reported descriptively.

webcam.limits: Four trials, one signer/session; descriptive diagnostic only. Full 2731-way versus restricted 15-way are different output tasks. No personal media or coordinates saved.
